title: The signed finite sum is additive in the summand
statement: `Int.sumRange (fun k => f k + g k) n = Int.sumRange f n + Int.sumRange g n`. Induction on the bound, with a four-summand regroup `(Sf+Sg)+(f n+g n) = (Sf+f n)+(Sg+g n)` from `Int.add_assoc` and `Int.add_comm` alone. The base case computes: both sides reduce to `Int.zero`, where the product analogue `Int.prodRange_mul` needs an explicit `Int.mul_one` because `Int.mul` reduces on neither symbolic operand. `Kernel::axiom_footprint` is EMPTY. Admitted by the trusted gate on the first attempt.

formal.statement: theorem Int.sumRange_add : ((x0 : ((x0 : AxNat) -> Int)) -> ((x1 : ((x1 : AxNat) -> Int)) -> ((x2 : AxNat) -> Eq.{1} Int (Int.sumRange (fun (x3 : AxNat) => Int.add (x0 x3) (x1 x3)) x2) (Int.add (Int.sumRange x0 x2) (Int.sumRange x1 x2)))))
